additional_info.subject: Case Note
additional_info.body:
Dear Support Team,
At charging station MP S6 170003725 (
AH5065DC001)
,
Connector 1 has repeatedly remained in a "Faulted" state since 26.02.2026
.
The station itself stays
online
, however recurring errors appear on both connector and charge point level.
Observed Error Pattern
Recurring vendor error codes:
"secc is initializing"
"ChargerOperationMode"
Example timeline
26.02.2026
Connector 1 →
Faulted
VendorErrorCode:
secc is initializing
03.03.2026
ChargePoint →
Faulted
VendorErrorCode:
ChargerOperationMode
Afterwards the station cycles between:
Available
Faulted
Unavailable
During these state changes,
Connector 1 remains continuously in a Faulted state
.
A
Collaborated Reboot
was triggered, but
did not resolve the issue
.
Current status (03.03.2026 – 14:08 UTC)
ChargePointStatus:
Available
ConnectivityStatus:
Online
EVSE 1 / Connector 1:
Faulted
ErrorCode:
OtherError
VendorErrorCode:
"secc is initializing"
Observation
It appears that the
SECC initialization process does not complete successfully
, causing the connector to remain in a permanent fault state.
Actions already taken
Remote reboot (Collaborated Reboot)
Backend status verification
→
No lasting improvement
Request
Please check:
SECC initialization / SECC module
meaning and cause of
ChargerOperationMode
error
potential firmware or hardware issues
whether a
field technician intervention
may be required
Please provide analysis and recommended next steps.
Thank you and kind regards
Alexandra
software version

Dear Alexandra,
Thank you for contacting us regarding the reported issue with outlet 1 on your charging station, referenced under ticket number 0482374.
Upon reviewing your report, our initial assessment indicates a potential concern with the temperature sensors located within the charging cable for outlet 1. This type of issue often requires a direct examination to ensure proper functionality and safety.
To facilitate a comprehensive resolution, an on-site inspection by our local technical team is essential. This visit will enable them to accurately diagnose the situation and carry out any necessary adjustments or repairs.
We have now transferred your case to our regional colleagues. They will be reaching out to you directly in the coming days to arrange a suitable time for this on-site service appointment.
We appreciate your cooperation and patience as we work to restore full functionality to your charging station. Should you have any questions in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.
With best regards,
